name: pledgestack-core
description: Core framework for PledgeStack — routing, rendering, and build pipeline
comment:optionalRuntimeDeps: The PSX integration JS fallbacks use optional runtime packages (pg, mysql2, redis, ioredis, argon2, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, sharp, puppeteer, nodemailer, xlsx). They are intentionally NOT declared as peerDependencies or optionalDependencies — pnpm auto-installs optional peers and npm/pnpm would install ~200MB of heavy native modules (puppeteer's Chromium, argon2's compiled addon, sharp's platform binaries) that most users never use. Install only the ones you use; each integration imports its package dynamically and throws a clear error with the exact install command if it is missing.
author: PledgeStack Contributors
